name: Yanase Takuma
source: Takuma is a university student. One day he gets a phone call from his mother telling him that his fathers factory went bankrupt. Due to this he can't pay his rent so he is forced to move out and find a new place soon he meets Miyama Yukino who overhears him and offers him to stay at the apartment where she is the caretaker.
